column1: # How often find method details agreed with an independent reading of the same papers, per FAIRe term.
# The tool sorts its proposals by these counts: a term it has proposed reliably is listed first, and the
# others are listed as values to check (see faire_method_details.py, reliability_of). Replace the counts
# as more papers are checked. papers_agreed: both gave a value and they agreed; papers_differed: both
# gave a value and they differed; papers_tool_only: the tool gave a value and the reading none;
# papers_missed: the reading gave a value and the tool none.
# Source: 29 published eDNA papers (19 development, 10 held out), read by Microsoft Copilot, November 2026;
# provisional until the readings have been checked by people.
